text:
lucy-sales: FYI - Acme POC is blocked on SSO/SCIM. They hit a 403 when we try to provision users into the Dedicated pool. They said SCIM API returns 'domain_not_allowed'. Can folks advise?

omar-solutions: :eyes: do we have the SCIM logs from their attempt? usually 403 domain errors mean the SCIM payload email domain didn't match tenant verified domains or the IdP is sending a different email attr.

ida-acme: we uploaded SAML metadata and set the SCIM base URL per the guide. Our IdP sends mail attribute as user@eng.acme.com but their SCIM user list uses primaryEmail acme.com. SCIM call error: 403 "domain_not_allowed".

raj-infra: we saw a similar failure last month. The platform enforces a verified_domains check for SCIM writes to Dedicated tenants to avoid cross-tenant provisioning. If the assertion email domain (eng.acme.com) isn't listed as a verified domain on the tenant, SCIM will be rejected.

omar-solutions: can you paste the SCIM payload (redact PII)? a common mismatch is sending `preferred_username` vs `emails[0].value`. Our SCIM expects emails[0].value by default. Example accepted payload: 
```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "j.smith@acme.com",
  "emails": [{"value": "j.smith@acme.com", "primary": true}]
}
```

sara-enterprise: also flagging: Acme has a security questionnaire in flight. They asked if we can manually provision a few admin accounts while they sort IdP domain claims. We should confirm a temporary process and limited scope API key for onboarding.

lucy-sales: they asked about pricing too — want to confirm Dedicated pool quotas before we spin up manual users. I'll handle pricing but need engineering confirmation we can safely create a handful of users for the PoC.

raj-infra: safe approach: add eng.acme.com as a verified domain on the tenant (we control that in the private control plane). If governance prevents changing tenant config, workaround is to map the IdP to send the claim with the base domain (j.smith@acme.com) OR we'll create users via the console using our provisioning admin (manual).

ida-acme: our IdP team said changing the claim is quick, but they need our guidance for the correct attribute mapping. They currently map `mail` -> SAML email, and `userPrincipalName` is different.

omar-solutions: tell them to map the SAML attribute `mail` to the SAML Subject or set `emails[0].value` in SCIM. For Okta, the app config should set 'Email' as the primary attribute and enable 'Send email as an attribute' in the profile mapping.

lucy-sales: can we provide a short checklist to pass to their IdP folks? If yes I'll push it over and offer a 1:1 call.

raj-infra: checklist (short):
 - Confirm SAML assertion contains the email in `mail` or `userPrincipalName`.
 - Ensure SCIM payload uses `emails[0].value` and matches the assertion domain.
 - If subdomains used (eng.acme.com), add subdomain to tenant verified_domains in the control plane.
 - Test SCIM using curl (token masked) and paste the error logs if any.

omar-solutions: sample curl for SCIM test: 
```bash
curl -X POST "https://scim.redwood.example/v2/Users" 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <SCIM_TOKEN>" 
 -H "Content-Type: application/scim+json" 
 -d '{"userName":"test@acme.com","emails":[{"value":"test@acme.com","primary":true}]}'
```

sara-enterprise: from security side: if we need to create a temporary API key for console provisioning, create a scoped key (provisioning:users:create) with 24h expiry and record token rotation. I'll also attach our SCIM logs retention and SOC2 section of the security pack in the thread for them.

ida-acme: ok we'll try adjusting the assertion to `mail` and retest. If that doesn't work, can Redwood manually add eng.acme.com to our verified domains? We need this POC live by EOD Friday.

lucy-sales: I'll coordinate timing. Omar, Raj — if we can do a quick manual domain add (if policy allows) that would unblock them. Sara, please prepare the scoped key process.

raj-infra: I can add the subdomain if legal confirms tenant boundary is fine — pinging deploy-bot to log the change and get audit record.

deploy-bot: [audit] requested change: add verified domain "eng.acme.com" to tenant "acme-tenant-123" by raj-infra. Approvals: pending (legal).

sara-enterprise: I'll loop in legal and get an approval thread going. In parallel, Lucy, offer the 30-min IdP mapping call.

lucy-sales: sending invite to Acme IdP and their engineering now.

ida-acme: thanks everyone — copying our IdP engineer @mike-okta. We'll try the mapping change and report back in ~30m.

omar-solutions: great — stand by. If they still get 403, paste the exact error body and we'll open a debug session.

lucy-sales: :thumbsup: closing the loop for now, will update when they confirm the retry.
